title: v ∧ ξ = 0 almost everywhere when the fixed vector v is tangent almost everywhere
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(U, n) (M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient), μ := R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M, and v ∈ ℝ^P. Suppose that for μ-a.e. x the orthogonal projection of v onto approxTangentPlane n M x (the approximate tangent plane T_xM, defined as ⊥ when none exists) equals v. Then for μ-a.e. x and every (n+1)-covector β on ℝ^P, ξ(x)(β.curryLeft v) = 0, where (β.curryLeft v)(w_1, …, w_n) = β(v, w_1, …, w_n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (v : Euclid P), (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection v = v) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), R.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft β v) = 0
